releases.name: Remote Reaper: FPV Drone
releases.summary: FPV drone simulator. Destroy enemy vehicles with high-precision strikes. Simulation of electronic warfare and realistic armor model.

releases.name: NIPH
releases.summary: NIPH is a stylish roguelite platformer with risky and intense combat. Slash, shoot, and learn and cast spells with more varied items as you explore a vast and diverse fantasy world!

releases.name: Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler
releases.summary:
Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler is 2.5D side-scrolling beat-'em-up where players experience the thrill of multiple unrivaled heroes, each with unique abilities. Master martial arts, unleash powerful skills, and conquer epic bosses. With local co-op for up to 4 players, team up for intense combat and a truly unforgettable adventure.

Set in medieval Indonesia, this game transports players to an era where powerful kingdoms ruled over vast archipelagos. Inspired by Indonesian folklore and mythology, legendary tales come to life through epic battles, brought together with stunning visuals that blend 2D and 3D elements.

Every chapter unfolds a new story, introducing fresh challenges, characters, and environments to explore. As the journey progresses, uncover deeper lore and unexpected twists that shape the world around you.

releases.name: The Witch's Bakery
releases.summary:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

releases.name: Rockfall
releases.summary:
Rockfall is a 2D mining game where every descent underground is a risk - and every treasure has a price.

Dig through shifting tunnels, mine valuable ores, gather resources, and upgrade your gear as you venture deeper into a dangerous underground world.

Armed with your pickaxe, a glowing companion, and pure determination, you explore ancient caverns, unstable tunnels, and forgotten dungeons filled with mystery.

But the deeper you go, the more dangerous it becomes. Collapsing traps, unstable terrain, and hidden secrets lie beneath the surface - and staying underground too long may awaken dangers you’re not ready to face.

releases.name: Gallery Organizer
releases.summary: A cozy organizing simulator where you hang up to 1,000 paintings in a messy art gallery. Find and earn helpful tools. Unwind in procedurally generated galleries showcasing real artists.

releases.name: Kyofu Yawa: Second Night
releases.summary: On a rainy night, three ghost stories are told in an old-fashioned café. As a writer for an occult magazine, you listen to three people recount their experiences. A psychological horror visual novel that slowly builds a sense of dread—Kyofu Yawa: Second Night.

releases.name: Ravenhill: Initiation
releases.summary: International Picnic Day is June 18, but you can get that outdoorsy feeling year 'round with Picnic Time!This picnic-themed app is no walk in the park, though. It's a big basket loaded with dozens of time wasters including tile slider games and memory matching diversions.Some of these games are annoyingly difficult. Because of that, there are no timers, no scores, no playing against friends – these challenges are simple and painful enough without outside distractions.You're competing only against yourself, staring into that deep abyss of sunshine and strawberries where you're the only one to blame. Good luck, dummy.The impossible memory matching games include things you take on a picnic, like delicious sandwiches, deli food, blankets, vintage picnic baskets, cups, plates, beer, wine, champagne, and even some surprises, like gross meats and people we picked named Nick.Picnic basket cases unite!

releases.name: PUGAD
releases.summary: PUGAD is a spearfishing horror game set on a secluded island in the Philippines. As a newbie diver, learn to hunt fish, upgrade your equipment, hone your diving skills, and discover what lurks in the depths.

releases.name: Tales From Eternity - Interactive Preview
releases.summary: Step into the universe of Tales From Eternity and experience the complete first two chapters through an atmospheric digital reader.

releases.name: The WHEELJAM Collection
releases.summary: A collection of over 20 games making up submissions from the WHEELJAM game jams in 2025 and 2026.

releases.name: Wok King
releases.summary: You and your friends run a Chinese restaurant in a cherry blossom town on an island. You travel to various places to purchase different quality ingredients, frantically completing orders in the kitchen, riding an e-bike to deliver the delicacies to customers, striving to become the wok king!
